title: Bluegill Triple Prime as missile defense, tied to SDI

tellings.quote:
Yeah, and that that in fact the Bluegill
Triple Prime thing was
it was a high-altitude nuclear test, but
it was a defense against Russian ICBMs

plain: Bluegill Triple Prime was a 1962 nuclear test set off high above the Pacific, and the claim is that it was really a defense against Russian long-range nuclear missiles, an early version of the 1980s American plan for missile defense in space. Jesse Michels repeats this from his guest Malmgren, billed in the episode's title as a CIA chief, who ties it to a paper from the RAND Corporation and to work at the Institute for Defense Analysis, both American defense research groups.
